Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached double spectral-arm concept illustration. Keep the SAME faceless right-facing male cultivator, his exact ordinary two human hands and pose, dark jade/ivory cloud-leaf clothing, ink-watercolor rendering, parchment background, and the appealing existing giant red hand gestures. This is a targeted COMPOSITION correction.
1) Move the ENTIRE spectral arm on SCREEN LEFT substantially farther LEFT/outward, including elbow, forearm, wrist and giant hand, to open more negative space above and beside the head. Its upper hand should be well left of the character's hair, not tucked over his head. Widen the framing as needed so all red contours and fingers remain inside the image. Do not merely move the left fingers while leaving the elbow crowded against the head.
2) Make the two giant spectral arms ALMOST THE SAME PHYSICAL SIZE. Enlarge the SCREEN-LEFT/far arm, especially its hand, so its palm, forearm thickness and fist mass are about 95-100% of the right/near arm. Near/far depth must come from overlaps, angle, subtle contrast and transparency, NOT from a much smaller left arm. Keep the right arm large and substantial.
3) These are DETACHED FLOATING MANIFESTATION ARMS behind the cultivator, like a many-armed spiritual avatar (法相), not new physical limbs growing out of his shoulders. Each complete arm has its own upper-arm root floating slightly behind and OUTSIDE the shoulder silhouette, around shoulder HEIGHT. Show an obvious small parchment gap between each root and the robe/shoulder, or clearly occlude the root behind the character with no bodily socket. Remove any solid anatomical join, shoulder bulb attached to clothing, or root glued onto the robe. Do not draw a larger body or torso connecting the arms. The two spectral arms collectively frame the figure from BEHIND. Far arm is behind the hair/body; a small near section can overlap the silhouette translucently to establish depth.
4) Preserve the raised-left / raised-right broad arch, two separate hands higher than the head with a clear central opening. Keep correct five-finger anatomy and the current restrained curled martial-ready hand gesture, palms inward. Do not introduce claw-like splay, an O hand seal, or rigid front-facing high-five palms.
Keep the blood-red translucent qi/glass membrane and controlled moving-light-like red brush accents, transparent interior, sculpted but spectral broad forms, not opaque flesh or armor. Exactly TWO giant spectral arms, TWO normal human arms and ONE head. No extra arms, heads, labels, UI, halos, full avatar body or changes to the character. Leave ample outer margins.
